comment: Every image a per-session vcluster can schedule, digest-pinned (multi-arch index digests). ensureVclusterImages mirrors each into the local registry under localTag, which is what the vendored manifests reference via the __YAAC_REGISTRY__ placeholder (defaultImageRegistry). Keep in lockstep with VERSION + values.yaml: the syncer/distro tags come from the chart, coredns + the rewriteHosts alpine are pinned in values.yaml / the chart defaults.
